presets.name: Minecraft Java – with /me emotes
presets.description: The built-in Minecraft Java preset plus /me emotes, which the server logs as "* Name action". The emote is posted in Discord as a chat message from that player.
presets.author: PteroSync contributors

presets.name: Terraria – TShock 5
presets.description: For TShock 5.x, which logs chat as "Name: message" instead of "<Name> message". Other console lines that look like "Word: text" (for example some plugin or error output) can also be posted as chat; add them to the ignore list if you see them. TShock 6 and vanilla servers should use the built-in Terraria preset.
presets.author: PteroSync contributors
